notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Scurry Oak.
You control another creature to sacrifice.
description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature, milling target player equal to its power.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Squirrel token, milling target player four.
Repeat from step 2.
